label: NVR301-08X-P8 8-channel PoE NVR
description: 8-channel 4K NVR, 1x 10/100 RJ45 LAN, 8x 10/100 RJ45 PoE (802.3af/at), 1 SATA to 8 TB.
notes: Figures taken from the vendor datasheet (V1.10, EN): 'Network Interface 1 RJ45 10M/100M self-adaptive', 'PoE Interface 8 RJ45 10M/100M self-adaptive', 'Max 30W for single port / Max 75W in total', IEEE 802.3at/af, 1 SATA up to 8 TB, 80 Mbps incoming. No gigabit anywhere on this model - do not upgrade the ports.

label: NV4108E-HS 8-channel PoE NVR
description: 8-channel 4K NVR, 1x gigabit RJ45 LAN, 1x independent 100M RJ45, 8x PoE (802.3af/at), 1 SATA to 6 TB.
notes: Datasheet lists two copper data ports separately: 'Interface 1 RJ-45 port (10/100/1000Mbps)' and 'Ethernet Port 1 Independent 100Mbps Ethernet Port'. PoE: 25.5 W single port, 80 W total, DC 48 V 2 A. One SATA III, 6 TB per disk, 80 Mbps record rate.

label: ND9425P 16-channel PoE NVR
description: 16-channel 4K NVR, 1x gigabit RJ45, 16x embedded 802.3at/af PoE totalling 200 W, 2 HDD bays with RAID 0/1.
notes: Specification tab: 'Ethernet 10/100/1000Mbps Ethernet (RJ-45) x1', 'PoE 802.3at/af compliant PoE ports x 16 (Total Max. 200 W)', 2 internal 3.5-inch bays, RAID 0/1, 64 Mbps recording, 88 Mbps total network throughput. Per-port watts are not published, so 30 W (802.3at Type 2 ceiling) is used per port while the aggregate stays at the published 200 W.

label: XRN-2010A 32-channel NVR
description: 32-channel 4K NVR, 2x gigabit RJ45 (LAN/WAN), 8 SATA bays to 48 TB, no PoE.
notes: Product specification sheet (02-2019): 'Ethernet RJ-45 2ea (LAN/WAN, 1Gbps)', 8 internal HDD (0-6 TB each, 48 TB max), 1 eSATA, 256 Mbps recording / 512 Mbps transmission, DHCP server and client in the protocol list. No PoE - cameras need a separate switch or injectors.
